description.value: Celista Estate Winery is an 80-acre vineyard on the north shore of Shuswap Lake, producing eight award-winning wines that have earned 115 medals in national and international competitions over 14 years. The estate features a tasting room with free wine samples, fine dining by R&M Foods, guided vineyard tours led by owner Jake Ootes, and four cabins overlooking the vineyard and lake. Kids and pets are explicitly welcome, and the property is wheelchair accessible.
